📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-27
1. Microsoft: ARTEX AI Pentest Framework Now in Arsenals of Chinese and North Korean Hackers資安
中國及北韓駭客皆已於武器庫中加入 ARTEX
Microsoft's analysis says at least six threat groups, including Storm-0940, Onyx Sleet and Salt Typhoon, have adopted the autonomous ARTEX framework. It can obtain privileged access to a target within minutes and set up persistence.
微軟公布 AI 自主滲透測試框架 ARTEX 的技術分析，指出至少 6 個駭客組織已採用。ARTEX 最快數分鐘即可取得目標組織特權存取並建立持久性存取機制。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180835
2. Nearly 4,200 AI Autonomous Attack Frameworks Exposed on the Public Internet, 10 Found in Taiwan資安
近 4,200 個 AI 自主攻擊框架暴露於公開網路，臺灣也發現 10 個
Open-source frameworks let attackers connect LLM agents to automate reconnaissance, vulnerability probing and credential harvesting. This speeds up intrusions and lowers the skill and labor needed to attack.
開源 AI 自主攻擊框架可串接 LLM 代理，自動執行偵察、漏洞探測與憑證蒐集，大幅加快入侵速度並降低攻擊門檻。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180843
3. Italy and Switzerland Warn of Agentic AI Attacks, Urge Patching Internet-Facing Systems Within 24 Hours資安
義大利、瑞士示警 AI 代理式攻擊，籲 24 小時內修補對外系統漏洞
After US, UK and Taiwan agencies, Italy's CSIRT reported attackers running multiple AI agents in parallel. In some cases large numbers of systems were compromised within hours.
繼美、英、臺之後，義大利 CSIRT 公告駭客同時運用多個 AI 代理執行攻擊，部分案例數小時內就入侵大量系統。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180821
4. Nvidia Hits Pause on Chip Shipments to Southeast Asia政策
Nvidia 暫停對東南亞的晶片出貨
Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens efforts to keep AI chips out of China.
美國加強防堵 AI 晶片流入中國，Nvidia 要求製造夥伴暫停對馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國與印尼的伺服器出貨。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/26/nvidia-hits-pause-on-chip-shipments-to-southeast-asia/
5. 1Password Employee's GitHub Account Hacked, Source Code Stolen and Malicious Code Planted資安
駭客入侵 1Password 員工 GitHub 帳號竊走原始碼，植入惡意程式碼下載客戶資料
Attackers accessed an employee's GitHub account, took source code and planted malicious code in a backend service to download some customer account-management data. 1Password says vaults and keys were not accessed.
攻擊者存取員工 GitHub 帳號、取得原始碼並在後端植入惡意程式碼，下載部分客戶帳號管理資料。1Password 強調密碼儲存庫與金鑰未被存取。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180820
6. Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains政策
Meta 拒絕分享 Muse 供測試，英國金融監管機構抱怨
The FCA warned of "another force of attack" from agents after Meta declined a request for joint testing ahead of launching its personal agent in the UK.
Meta 在英國推出個人代理 Muse 前，拒絕了 FCA 的聯合測試請求，FCA 警告代理可能成為「另一股攻擊力量」。
Wired · https://www.wired.com/story/meta-refused-to-share-muse-for-testing-uk-financial-watchdog-complains/
7. OpenAI Begins Merging ChatGPT Chat and Work Interfaces, Shared Quota Expanding in December產品
OpenAI 開始合併 ChatGPT 的 Chat 與 Work 介面，預定 12 月擴大部署共用配額
After unifying ChatGPT Work and Codex usage quotas earlier this month, OpenAI is merging Chat and Work for a small group of Pro users, with wider rollout of shared quotas planned for December.
ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 本月稍早整合用量配額後，OpenAI 開始對少數 Pro 用戶合併 Chat 和 Work，預定 12 月擴大部署。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180807
8. 42 State AGs Try to Stop Character.AI From Selling Users' Chats政策
42 州檢察長試圖阻止 Character.AI 出售使用者對話
A coalition of 42 attorneys general is trying to block Character.AI from auctioning user data during its Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The sale reportedly includes data from over 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors.
42 州檢察長聯盟試圖阻止 Character.AI 在破產程序中拍賣使用者資料，涉及逾 2,100 萬個美國帳號，其中 210 萬個為未成年人。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/policy/1042620/character-ai-sale-state-ags-block-selling-users-chats
9. Australia Passes Digital Duty of Care Law Covering AI Chatbots, Fines Up to 5% of Global Revenue政策
澳洲立法強化 AI 聊天機器人與社群平臺安全責任，違規罰款可達全球營收 5%
Parliament passed the Digital Duty of Care bill on Nov 25, requiring social media, games and AI chatbots to proactively prevent serious harm. Penalties reach the higher of 5% of global revenue or A$109.2 million, effective in 12 months.
澳洲國會 11 月 25 日通過數位注意義務法案，要求社群、遊戲與 AI 聊天機器人主動防範嚴重傷害；罰款上限為全球營收 5% 或 1.092 億澳元取高者，12 個月後生效。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180825
10. Exploited Drupal Critical Flaw Fail2Install Detailed by Researchers資安
研究人員揭露已遭利用的 Drupal 重大漏洞 Fail2Install 細節
The Drupal flaw CVE-2026-132165 (CVSS 9.8) has been exploited, and CISA confirmed it this week. Researchers say it is dangerous across many common Drupal deployment environments.
Drupal 重大漏洞 CVE-2026-132165（CVSS 9.8）已遭利用並獲 CISA 證實，研究指出在多種常見部署環境下都能造成危害。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180838
